node.label: Court cases in news
node.summary: Notable Supreme Court and High Court orders not filed under a bigger topic.

facts.text: Delhi HC (Acting CJ **Nitin Wasudeo Sambre**) refused to stay the entry ban on non-BS-VI outside vehicles; next hearing 27 Nov.
facts.plain: Delhi HC (Acting CJ Nitin Wasudeo Sambre) refused to stay the entry ban on non-BS-VI outside vehicles; next hearing 27 Nov.

facts.text: SC told Mokama MLA **Anant Singh** to surrender by **1 Dec** in the Dular Chand Yadav murder case.
facts.plain: SC told Mokama MLA Anant Singh to surrender by 1 Dec in the Dular Chand Yadav murder case.

facts.text: Bombay HC extended its stay on the 'Leave India Notice' to actor **Imran Khan**, a US citizen holding an **OCI** card.
facts.plain: Bombay HC extended its stay on the 'Leave India Notice' to actor Imran Khan, a US citizen holding an OCI card.

facts.text: Delhi HC stayed JNU's dismissal of professor and Congress MP **Angomcha Bimol Akoijam** after a sexual harassment inquiry.
facts.plain: Delhi HC stayed JNU's dismissal of professor and Congress MP Angomcha Bimol Akoijam after a sexual harassment inquiry.

facts.text: Muzaffarnagar riots (2013): a court acquitted eight people in a murder case for lack of evidence.
facts.plain: Muzaffarnagar riots (2013): a court acquitted eight people in a murder case for lack of evidence.

facts.text: Bombay HC (Goa) ordered **₹20 lakh** interim compensation each to families of the **25** killed in the **Birch by Romeo Lane** nightclub fire, Arpora (6 Dec 2025).
facts.plain: Bombay HC (Goa) ordered ₹20 lakh interim compensation each to families of the 25 killed in the Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub fire, Arpora (6 Dec 2025).

facts.text: SC closed pleas for a CBI probe into the **Ram Temple donation fraud** after UP's SIT filed a chargesheet. Petitioners may assist the trial court as 'victims of crime'.
facts.plain: SC closed pleas for a CBI probe into the Ram Temple donation fraud after UP's SIT filed a chargesheet. Petitioners may assist the trial court as 'victims of crime'.

facts.text: CJI **Surya Kant** flagged litigants' 'growing tendency' to rush to the Supreme Court for early hearings even as **65,54,788 cases** remain pending in High Courts (25 High Courts face 292 judicial vacancies against a sanctioned strength of 1,122) and the Supreme Court's own backlog nears one lakh (97,201 cases).
facts.plain: CJI Surya Kant flagged litigants' 'growing tendency' to rush to the Supreme Court for early hearings even as 65,54,788 cases remain pending in High Courts (25 High Courts face 292 judicial vacancies against a sanctioned strength of 1,122) and the Supreme Court's own backlog nears one lakh (97,201 cases).

facts.text: Gujarat HC Division Bench (CJ **Manash Ranjan Pathak**, Justice Nirzar Desai) stayed a single judge's order and restored the Collector's ban (10 Aug 2026) on preparing and selling **non-veg food within 500 m of Somnath temple** and on six pilgrimage roads in Gir Somnath.
facts.plain: Gujarat HC Division Bench (CJ Manash Ranjan Pathak, Justice Nirzar Desai) stayed a single judge's order and restored the Collector's ban (10 Aug 2026) on preparing and selling non-veg food within 500 m of Somnath temple and on six pilgrimage roads in Gir Somnath.
keys: non-veg food within 500 m of Somnath temple

facts.text: Ram Temple donation theft (Ayodhya): charges against eight accused could not be framed for a third time; CCTV showed 105 instances of money being removed; FIR on 25 June. Congress asked why Trust officials **Champat Rai** and **Anil Mishra** were only witnesses.
facts.plain: Ram Temple donation theft (Ayodhya): charges against eight accused could not be framed for a third time; CCTV showed 105 instances of money being removed; FIR on 25 June. Congress asked why Trust officials Champat Rai and Anil Mishra were only witnesses.

facts.text: Kerala HC told police not to arrest an additional district judge whose 17-year-old son drove a car that caused a fatal crash at **Cheranalloor**.
facts.plain: Kerala HC told police not to arrest an additional district judge whose 17-year-old son drove a car that caused a fatal crash at Cheranalloor.

facts.text: Constitutional link: **Article 48** (Directive Principle) asks the State to organise agriculture and animal husbandry on scientific lines and to prohibit slaughter of cows and calves; cow protection laws are State subjects.
facts.plain: Constitutional link: Article 48 (Directive Principle) asks the State to organise agriculture and animal husbandry on scientific lines and to prohibit slaughter of cows and calves; cow protection laws are State subjects.

facts.text: A Gandhinagar (Gujarat) court gave **life imprisonment** to three men for cow slaughter (277 kg beef), quoting the **Manusmriti**. A **2017** amendment to the **Gujarat Animal Preservation Act, 1954** made Gujarat the first State to prescribe life terms for cow slaughter.
facts.plain: A Gandhinagar (Gujarat) court gave life imprisonment to three men for cow slaughter (277 kg beef), quoting the Manusmriti. A 2017 amendment to the Gujarat Animal Preservation Act, 1954 made Gujarat the first State to prescribe life terms for cow slaughter.

facts.text: Allahabad HC granted bail to SP leader **Azam Khan** and son **Abdullah Azam Khan** in the fake passport and **dual PAN card** case, suspending their sentence but not staying the conviction.
facts.plain: Allahabad HC granted bail to SP leader Azam Khan and son Abdullah Azam Khan in the fake passport and dual PAN card case, suspending their sentence but not staying the conviction.

facts.text: Delhi HC (Justice **Anish Dayal**) refused to restore worshippers' access to the **Race Course mosque** in Lutyens' Delhi amid demolition work nearby; the Centre said it would decide on the **Delhi Waqf Board's** plea within four weeks.
facts.plain: Delhi HC (Justice Anish Dayal) refused to restore worshippers' access to the Race Course mosque in Lutyens' Delhi amid demolition work nearby; the Centre said it would decide on the Delhi Waqf Board's plea within four weeks.
